title: Registration in Bitclub Network HD
description: The Crypto Invest team presents to you a video review on how to register on Bitclub Network.

asr.full_text: Good time of the day, friends! Crypto Invest team is with you. And now we'll show you how to register with BTC Network To begin with, you need to get a partnership link for registration. Without a partnership link, it is impossible to register in the Club. Once you are subscribed, you will go to the company site. Then you need to click the Sign up button. Then the registration window opens. You need to fill in all the fields. When filling in the field Address of email, It is advisable to use the Gmail email address. After filling in all fields, click on the button to create an account. After that, we will be redirected to the page for activating our e-mail. To activate the mail, click on the Send Verification code button. Next, go to the mail that we indicated during registration and copy the sent mail to us. Now write your email go to this email address, that we posted before registration, and copy the code, that was sent to us. Now go back to activation page and insert the copied code, and press the blue click. Now we will see this confirmation that the activation was successful. Now just pay your membership in the club membership in the Club for $99. To do this, click on the BTC Network.com page to select the Welcome item. Then press Create user name. Then you need to carry out two steps of the program. In the first step, create an user name, then create a password and confirm the password. After filling the fields, go down a little below the page and move to step number 2 and click on the green button to activate the account. A window showed up, where the payment amount and time are displayed 10 minutes, which is given for payment membership. You need to send within 10 minutes., click send and click on send. Then in the field Whom, we enter the bitcoin address, and then we click send. And now to join us, let's see how this wallet is opened. First, we need to check that our wallet has come to him. Well, I can also give him an email. This message says that he has come to the blockchain wallet, click on the Send button. Next, we insert the bitcoin address, which we have copied in our BitClap Network account in the Who field. Next, we copy the amount recorded in bitcoins on the BitClub website and insert it into the BTC-blockchain wallet window. the blockchain wallet. To access Bitclub faster, choose a priority send in the Commission window, then click on the following Step for sending payment. How to pay, wait auto update BITCLUB NETWORK page. After you get an account will appear on top this section. To make sure you have bought account, click on My Account button. then click on My Groceries. In this section we can see the history of our orders. Here it is written that we took an account. This is Confirmed status. which means that the purchase is confirmed. Now you need to buy a pool for mining, click on the welcome button. Lower the page and find the pools for mining Bitcoin. Select the required one by pressing the button on the selected pool Buy Right Now. Next, the same window opens, as well as paying membership in the club, which means we are making the same actions As you pay, wait for auto-updating of the BitClub Network page. on the other hand, I will also use the Bitcoin account in which the bitcoin coin has been registered with Bitcoin from my own account. To make sure that the bitcoin is purchased, go to my account, then to my purchases. And look at the history of our orders, our pool will start mining bitcoins in 30 days from the date of the registration review of BitClub Network. I hope this video was useful to you. The crypto Invest team was with you. Join our team and earn together with us in the crypto industry.

textual.observation: Registration is presented as requiring a partnership link, with registration described as impossible without that link.

evidence.quote: you need to get a partnership link for registration. Without a partnership link, it is impossible to register in the Club.

textual.context: The source presents this as part of a registration tutorial; whether the link is promotional, referral-based or discussed for another purpose is not independently established.
textual.potential_relevance: A required partnership or referral link is tied to access to registration, creating an unusual registration condition that may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish who provides the link, whether it benefits the provider, or whether the registration process is legitimate.

textual.observation: The tutorial instructs viewers to pay a $99 club membership by sending bitcoin, with a 10-minute payment period.

evidence.quote: Now just pay your membership in the club membership in the Club for $99.
amount and time are displayed 10 minutes, which is given for payment membership.
Then in the field Whom, we enter the bitcoin address, and then we click send.

textual.context: The source gives step-by-step payment instructions in a registration tutorial. It does not state that payment resulted in a loss or establish the recipient's identity.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated membership payment is linked to a requested bitcoin transfer and a 10-minute deadline, combining a financial action with an urgency condition.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the payment amount, bitcoin address, deadline or membership offering is genuine, deceptive or associated with any loss.

textual.observation: After membership registration, the tutorial instructs viewers to buy a Bitcoin mining pool and states that the pool will start mining bitcoins in 30 days.

evidence.quote: Now you need to buy a pool for mining, click on the welcome button.
our pool will start mining bitcoins in 30 days from the date of the registration review of BitClub Network.

textual.context: The source presents the mining-pool purchase and future mining statement as part of a promotional registration walkthrough.
textual.potential_relevance: A purchase request is linked to a stated future cryptocurrency-mining outcome with a 30-day timeframe, which may require assessment of the promised return or service.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the amount or terms of the pool purchase, actual mining activity, profitability, or whether any bitcoins were received.

textual.observation: The speaker invites viewers to join the team and earn together in the cryptocurrency industry.

evidence.quote: Join our team and earn together with us in the crypto industry.

textual.context: This is a direct promotional invitation at the end of a registration and purchase tutorial; the precise meaning of joining and earning is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A recruitment or affiliation request is directly linked to an earning claim, creating a relationship between audience participation and a promised financial outcome.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the earning mechanism, eligibility, amount, timeframe, required payment or whether the statement is a guarantee.

visual.observation: A BitClub-branded webpage advertises an innovative and lucrative way to earn Bitcoin and presents a sign-up form requesting an account identifier, an email address, a country selection, and account registration.
visual.context: Promotional website presentation; whether the offer is being promoted by the video creator or merely shown is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised Bitcoin-earning outcome is linked to account registration and submission of contact information, which may merit review as a reward claim tied to a requested action.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish that any Bitcoin was earned, that the information was misused, or that the website or offer was fraudulent.

visual.observation: An account page instructs the user to activate a full package by completing account setup and paying a one-time fee of 99 US dollars.
visual.context: Visible account activation and payment instructions within the BitClub website flow.
visual.potential_relevance: Access to the promoted package is conditioned on a monetary payment, linking the advertised service to a required transfer of funds.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show whether payment was completed, what service was ultimately delivered, or whether the fee was legitimate.

visual.observation: A Bitcoin payment page displays a specified BTC amount, a cryptocurrency receiving address, and a QR code for sending the payment.
visual.context: Payment interface associated with a BitClub mining-pool package; the destination address and QR code are visible but not independently verified.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface requests a cryptocurrency transfer to obtain or activate a package, creating a concrete payment-flow cue linked to the service offer.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish ownership of the address, whether funds were sent, or what happened after payment. The QR code and wallet addresses are not decoded or verified.

visual.observation: A BitClub page displays mining-pool package tiles with dollar-denominated amounts and visible purchase buttons, alongside text describing profits from Bitcoin and other virtual currencies under stated conditions.
visual.context: Promotional mining-pool package page with stated conditions and purchase options.
visual.potential_relevance: Claims about potential cryptocurrency profits are presented together with purchasable package options, linking a return claim to a paid action.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not establish the actual return, the full terms, or whether the displayed figures are guarantees, examples, or package prices.

visual.observation: The site requires email verification before account access, including sending a verification code and entering that code on the page.
visual.context: Account-verification step within the same website flow; the page states that the email address has not been verified.
visual.potential_relevance: A contact method and verification action are required as part of accessing the account associated with the Bitcoin-earning offer.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish whether the email address belongs to the viewer, whether the code was received, or whether the account provided any promised benefit.

textual_context_notes.observation: The content is described as a review and is delivered as a step-by-step registration tutorial for Bitclub Network.

evidence.quote: The Crypto Invest team presents to you a video review on how to register on Bitclub Network.
And now we'll show you how to register with BTC Network

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled sequence shows browser pages moving through a BitClub-branded promotional page, registration and email verification, account activation, package information, and Bitcoin payment screens.
Some payment screens display countdown timers and package or account totals, but the sparse samples do not establish the timing or outcome of any transaction.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub registration, instructing viewers to pay a $99 membership fee in Bitcoin through a displayed payment amount and receiving address. It also directs viewers to purchase mining pools costing hundreds or thousands of dollars while associating those purchases with future Bitcoin mining and earning claims. the available video evidence does not claim that payment was completed, that anyone suffered a loss, or that the service actually performed as described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker directs viewers to buy a mining pool and claims that the purchased pool will subsequently mine bitcoins; the displayed page also pairs mining-pool purchase options with conditional profit language.
